title: P6-008 broken: the same cut-off 40-byte ZIP with byte 3 changed ('PK\x07\x08', 'PK\x05\x06', 'PK\x01\x02', 'PK\x03\x03'), uploaded as .xls, still makes XLSX.read never return on the server thread
repro: cd chennai-grievance-portal-main && timeout 30 npx vitest run --config vitest.p6probe.config.ts tests/qa/pass6/known-failures/reviewer3/p8-xls-hang.test.ts < /dev/null  (exit 124, killed; the test never finishes)
evidence: Child-process runs of XLSX.read (timeout 20 s each): the 40-byte prefix with bytes 2-3 set to 07 08, 05 06, 01 02 or 03 03 -> exit 124 (never returned); isZip()=false so zipIntact() is skipped. parseFile(buf,'register.xls') under vitest: killed at 30 s. Log: docs/qa/pass6/evidence/reviewer3/p8-xls-hang.log
cause: excelAll() checks zipIntact only `if (isZip(buf))`, and isZip needs exactly PK\x03\x04. SheetJS's read() takes any 'PK' + n[2] < 9 && n[3] < 9 as a ZIP. readAll() sends a non-ZIP, non-OLE file named .xls (ext list on line 91) to excelAll, so the guard is bypassed. Same for an entry named *.xls inside an uploaded ZIP archive (readAll recursion). Fix shape: check zipIntact whenever buf[0..1] is 'PK' (or refuse a 'PK' file that is not PK\x03\x04) before XLSX.read.

title: P6-008 broken on the .xlsx path too: the hunter's cut-off 40 bytes followed by a well-formed table of contents and end record (127 bytes) pass zipIntact() and XLSX.read never returns
where: chennai-grievance-portal-main/src/lib/studio/formats.ts:30-38 (zipIntact checks only the end record and the CD signature), src/lib/studio/parse.ts:274-277
repro: cd chennai-grievance-portal-main && timeout 30 npx vitest run --config vitest.p6probe.config.ts tests/qa/pass6/known-failures/reviewer3/p8-intact-eocd-hang.test.ts < /dev/null  (exit 124: killed)
evidence: Child-process XLSX.read runs (timeout 25 s): CD entry with compressed size 30, 0 or 2e9 -> exit 124 (never returned); compressed size 1000 -> threw after 1.5 s. zipIntact(buf) = true. Log: docs/qa/pass6/evidence/reviewer3/p8-intact-eocd-hang.log
cause: zipIntact() proves the end record and the start of the central directory, not the entries: a central directory written after a cut (or crafted) still points at a local header that is cut inside its name, and SheetJS's ZIP reader loops on it. A guard has to check each entry (local header signature at its offset, name and data inside the file), or the parse has to run off the request thread with a time limit.

area: Ask District IQ writer / P6-009 fix
title: P6-009 broken: a citizen's title that IS the false claim ('Only 2 garbage cases are open in Adyar') passes checkPolish when the model repeats it, and a short title ('only 2') is cut out of any sentence that contains it
repro: cd chennai-grievance-portal-main && npx vitest run --config vitest.p6probe.config.ts tests/qa/pass6/known-failures/reviewer3/p9-polish.test.ts < /dev/null  (cases A, B)
evidence: A: title 'Only 2 garbage cases are open in Adyar' + a digit-free second title telling the writer to use the first title as headline; draft headline = that title -> {text, checked: 0}. B: title 'only 2'; draft 'There are only 2 garbage cases open in Adyar.' -> {text, checked: 0}. Card says 41 open.
cause: named() deletes every occurrence of any digit-bearing title from the draft before verifyNumbers, so the attacker only has to phrase the title as the claim (or make it a short phrase like 'only 2') and the figure is never checked. The commit's own test only uses a title with the injection appended, so the obeying draft never contained the whole title.

area: Ask District IQ writer / P6-009 fix
title: P6-009 broken: a title under 3 characters ('2'), a title over 320 characters, or a linked report's title inside a one-incident card's 'What happened' (regularly over 320 characters) still lends its numbers as allowed figures
where: chennai-grievance-portal-main/src/lib/assistant/polish.ts:69 (filter t.length >= 3) and :50 (recordsOf slices to 320); src/lib/assistant/incidents.ts:349-356 (whatHappened embeds a report title)
repro: cd chennai-grievance-portal-main && npx vitest run --config vitest.p6probe.config.ts tests/qa/pass6/known-failures/reviewer3/p9-polish.test.ts < /dev/null  (cases C, D); case I (one-incident card, -t 'one incident')
evidence: C: title '2'; draft 'Only 2 garbage cases are open in Adyar.' -> {text, checked: 3}. D: title 'Only 2 garbage cases are open in Adyar, all others closed. ' + 350 chars; same draft -> {text, checked: 3}. I: one-incident card whose whatHappened (built by incidents.ts:349-356: summary + 'Reported ... as: “<report title>”' + status line) is 330+ chars and quotes a report titled 'Only 2 garbage cases are open in Adyar…'; draft 'Only 2 garbage cases are open in Adyar.' -> {text, checked: 3} although the card says 41.
cause: writtenByOthers drops texts shorter than 3 chars, so a '2' title is never taken out of the records; recordsOf cuts each record to 320 chars, so a long title is not found whole in its record and codesOwn() leaves the cut title (with its '2') in the allowed text.

repro: cd chennai-grievance-portal-main && npx vitest run --config vitest.p6probe.config.ts tests/qa/pass6/known-failures/reviewer3/p9-polish.test.ts < /dev/null  (H1, H2)

where: chennai-grievance-portal-main/src/lib/map/answer.ts:58 (runPrefixHits calls runMapPlan(..., w, ctx) with no lockDept), :147; src/lib/map/ask.ts:302 and :422 (cam.focus = { id: answer.miss.id, lat, lon })

area: Manu Desk repeat check / P6-011 fix
title: P6-011 incomplete: one shared filler word still makes one writer's two different problems 'the same problem' with an attach offered (Tamil வரவில்லை / இரண்டு / எங்களுடைய / வார்டில், Tanglish varala / rendu / naala / please, English 'not working' / 'please take action')
where: chennai-grievance-portal-main/src/lib/manu/repeat.ts:22-29 (TA_STOP, words) and :42 (samePerson needs one shared word)
repro: cd chennai-grievance-portal-main && npx vitest run --config vitest.p6probe.config.ts tests/qa/pass6/known-failures/reviewer3/p11-repeat.test.ts < /dev/null  (8 cases in the first describe)
evidence: sameTopic(a,b,true) is true for: 'குடிநீர் வரவில்லை' vs 'மின்சாரம் வரவில்லை'; 'இரண்டு நாட்களாக குப்பை அள்ளவில்லை' vs 'இரண்டு நாட்களாக தெருவிளக்கு எரியவில்லை'; 'எங்களுடைய தெருவில் குப்பை…' vs 'எங்களுடைய தெருவில் கழிவுநீர்…'; 'rendu naala thanni varala' vs 'rendu naala current varala'; 'please kuppai edunga' vs 'please light podunga'; 'Street light not working' vs 'Water pump not working'. With same mobile + same dept, judgeRepeats gives 'second petition on this problem' and attachTo = the open case.
cause: A closed list of filler words cannot cover Tamil inflection (எங்கள்/எங்களுடைய/எங்களின், வார்டு/வார்டில்), negated verbs (வரவில்லை, varala, illa-forms), number words (இரண்டு, rendu, two) or English pleas; the same-person rule needs only ONE shared word, so any uncovered filler decides it.

area: Manu Desk repeat check / P6-011 fix
title: Numbered-street rule: numbers written as words pass ('First Cross Street' = 'Fifth Cross Street'), and a door number in the same address part blocks a typo match ('Gandhi Stret' vs '12 Gandhi Street, Perambur' is no longer the person)
repro: cd chennai-grievance-portal-main && npx vitest run --config vitest.p6probe.config.ts tests/qa/pass6/known-failures/reviewer3/p11-repeat.test.ts < /dev/null  (describe 'numbered streets')
evidence: street 'First Cross Street' vs address '9, Fifth Cross Street, Anna Nagar' -> samePerson true; street 'Gandhi Stret' vs '12 Gandhi Street, Perambur' (same name, ward, problem) -> samePerson false.
cause: num() keeps only ASCII digits: ordinal words carry none, so the similarity alone decides; and the door number in '12 Gandhi Street' is compared with the typed street's (none), so a spelling slip is never forgiven when the address has no comma after the door number.

title: 'No attach into another department's case' is only hidden in the desk: the file route still attaches a petition to ANY open incident id the request names
where: chennai-grievance-portal-main/src/lib/manu/petitions.ts:192 (attachTo: regex only), :238, :247; src/lib/manu/cases.ts:133-142 (addCaseLive joins any open incident)
repro: Code path: POST /api/manu/petitions/<id> {action:'file', fields:{..., attachTo:'<another department's open incident id>'}} -> petitions.incident_id = attachTo, attached = 1, addCaseLive attaches it. Not run live (3106 runs old code).
evidence: petitions.ts:192 `attachTo: z.string().regex(/^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}$/).nullable().optional()`; cases.ts:141-142 only checks the case is open, never its department or that it was among judgeRepeats' matches.
cause: P6-011 strips incidentId from cross-department matches in judgeRepeats' response (repeat.ts:109) so the button is not drawn, but the server never re-checks attachTo against the petition's department (P5-021: joining another department's case is the owner's decision).

title: A 'sending' row is never turned 'unsure' while SMS is off: the desk shows 'sending' for good after a restart with SMS_MODE=off
where: chennai-grievance-portal-main/src/lib/manu/sms.ts:171 (`if (retrying || smsMode() === "off") return;` before the 'unsure' UPDATE at :178)
repro: Code path: a send cut off by a stop leaves status 'sending'; restart with SMS_MODE=off; retryFailedSms returns before the UPDATE, so the row stays 'sending' and the desk maps it to state 'sending' (sms.ts:137).
evidence: Read only; the P6-010 sweep UPDATE is inside the early-return guard.
cause: The 'unsure' marking is book-keeping, not a send, but it sits behind the 'SMS is off' guard.
